adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, immediately after `const credentialKey = credential.key as unknown as ExtendedTokenResponse;`, the code performs a token refresh HTTP POST to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` and then unconditionally updates `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: ... } })` before returning the `jsforce.Connection`. There is no expiry/validity check (e.g., only refresh when access token is expired) and no memoization/caching shown in the diff, so every call that reaches this code path will incur an external refresh + DB write, matching the finding’s latency/load/rate-limit concern. The diff does not show any guard to prevent repeated refreshes.
